note: The grader's knobs (hidden with the tests). The pick rules and the instrument are the public files setup_payload/hand_instrument.py and instrument_config.json (envelope: true would also plan and execute with setup_payload/hand_envelope.json, which the payload then ships; false = no envelope and no such file); the gate and the standard simulation are setup_payload/twin_gate.py, twin_sim.py and twin_sim_config.json. thing_cap is the floor of the per-thing cap: a thing carries at most max(thing_cap, 1 / n) of the use, n = the things with a credit unit. request_set is the build's stop line, checked by the self-test (below it: a task error, never a score). Lengths in mm, times in s, memory in MB. internal_leaves lists the leaves no document states.
